caption.title: Product Description
caption.description:
Modular 3D sensor platform for robotics, education, laboratories, and innovative applications.

Discover the future of 3D sensing with our versatile platform, designed specifically for robotics enthusiasts, educational institutions, labs, and forward-thinking developers. This system combines advanced sensor technologies with powerful onboard processing to capture and analyze precise 3D data in real time.

Comprehensive API for developing custom applications in robotics, machine vision, AI, and lab data analysis
Power over Ethernet (PoE) for power, control, and video transmission in a single cable

services_section.title: Application Areas
services_section.description: Temas features an integrated multi-sensor architecture, motor control, an open API, and a mechanical interface for easy integration into a wide range of applications – from robotic systems to smart home projects.

services.title: Robotics
services.description: Temas combines a mechanical interface with a multi-sensor architecture – including visual camera, ToF camera, and laser – plus fast and precise motors. The integrated single-cable PoE solution ensures efficient power and data transmission. The open API enables seamless integration into mobile robotic systems and collaborative cobots.

services.title: 3D Mapping & Surveying
services.description: Tailored flexibility: Two powerful options for precise mapping – the laser for large-scale applications and the ToF camera for impressive, detailed live point clouds – perfect for dynamic close-range scenarios.

services.title: Research & Education
services.description: Experience digital education: Visualize live experiments, integrate measurement data seamlessly into labs or lectures, and make physical phenomena – such as free-fall, pendulum, or velocity experiments – interactive and tangible.

services.title: Artificial Intelligence
services.description: The multi-sensor setup generates rich training data – combining RGB images, depth data, and geometry. Especially by fusing ToF and laser data with visual camera images, detection accuracy can be significantly enhanced.

services.title: Virtual Reality
services.description: In combination with a VR headset, our sensor system makes complex environments immersively tangible in real time – ideal for interactive visualization, hands-on training, and remote collaboration in research, industry, and education.

services.title: Smart Home & IoT
services.description: Our sensor system captures spaces, objects, and motion in the smart home precisely in 3D and real time. It detects changes and lays the foundation for intelligent automation, adaptive security systems, and enhanced living comfort. Power and data transmission are efficiently handled via a single cable – thanks to integrated Power-over-Ethernet (PoE) technology.

content.text: The foundation for our technology was laid in 2019 when we – Dr. Emre Gürdal and Muhammed Tayar – joined forces with a shared vision for digital environmental sensing. In 2025, the official company was founded with the goal of combining precision, openness, and versatility in one compact system. Our technology combines an integrated multi-sensor architecture, consisting of visual camera, ToF camera, and laser, with fast and precise motor movement. The system is complemented by open interfaces – both mechanical and software (API) – enabling precise 3D mapping and seamless integration into a wide range of applications. Whether in robotics, smart home, mobile platforms, or educational environments: our system generates point clouds in real time, exports them directly in .ply format, and supports both live visualization and immediate post-processing. As an optoelectronic component, our system is ideal for robotics applications and ensures highly precise, real-time environment sensing for safe and efficient navigation.

faq_section.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq_section.description: Here you’ll find answers to common questions about Temas.

faqs.question: Which sensors are built into the device?
faqs.answer: The device features a visual camera, a ToF camera, a LiDAR laser, and two precisely controllable motors.

faqs.question: How can I control Temas?
faqs.answer: Temas can be precisely controlled via an Ethernet interface and integrated into existing networks.

faqs.question: Are example API codes available?
faqs.answer: Yes, example API usage codes are available in our GitHub repository.

faqs.question: Is Temas AI capable?
faqs.answer: Temas can be combined with popular AI frameworks via the open API. Discover our example codes and applications on GitHub – ideal for a quick start.

faqs.question: Is the device compatible with existing smart home systems?
faqs.answer: Yes, the open API allows flexible integration of the device into common smart home platforms.

faqs.question: How can the device be operated?
faqs.answer: Temas can be operated via our software for Windows and macOS or flexibly via the open API.

faqs.question: How is the device powered?
faqs.answer: Temas is powered via Power-over-Ethernet (PoE) – simplifying installation and eliminating additional cabling.

faqs.question: Is a power supply included?
faqs.answer: A power supply is not included. We recommend the following model: Manufacturer TP-Link, Model PoE260S.
